sentence: The Epilepsy Foundation, a national nonprofit founded in 1968, says it began organizing a November awareness campaign in 1969; this calendar found that claim repeated by an actual Foundation regional affiliate, the Epilepsy Foundation of Northeastern New York, but could not check it against a dated primary Foundation document, so it is treated as an organizational self-report rather than an independently verifiable fact, the same caveat this calendar applies to the American Diabetes Association's parallel 1975 claim for [American Diabetes Month](/diabetes-awareness-month/).\n\nWhat is independently checkable, in the primary congressional record, is that Congress has tried three separate times to put a federal designation behind that campaign, and none of the three attempts succeeded.
